title: Presheaf extension by zero on a localized site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $W$ an object [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For an abelian presheaf $F$ on the slice category $\mathcal C/W$ (presheaves of abelian groups as in [def-sp-abelian]), define the presheaf $j_{W,p!}F$ on $\mathcal C$ by

$$
(j_{W,p!}F)(V)= igoplus_{\varphi\in\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(V,W)}F(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}W),
$$

where the summand indexed by $\varphi$ is the value of $F$ at the corresponding slice object, and a morphism $g:V'	o V$ sends the summand indexed by $\varphi$ to the summand indexed by $\varphi\circ g$ using the restriction map of $F$. A morphism of presheaves is sent to the direct sum of its component maps. If $\mathcal C$ is a site and $F$ is a sheaf on $\mathcal C/W$, the extension-by-zero sheaf $j_{W!}F$ is the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $j_{W,p!}F$ for the given topology on $\mathcal C$.
